vocabulary.meaning_en: a word you say when you meet someone
an informal way to say hello
your own name, not your family name
see and talk to someone for the first time
vocabulary.example: I meet new people at work.

vocabulary.note_en: It usually goes at the end of the sentence.
Always write it with a capital letter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person you are talking to
vocabulary.example: What's your name? Who are you?

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to ask about a thing or information
a person you know and like

fine_lines.title: he / she
fine_lines.explanation_ar: he للرجل أو الولد، و she للمرأة أو البنت. العربية تفرّق بينهما أيضًا: هو / هي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "he" for a man or boy and "she" for a woman or girl.

fine_lines.title: his / her
fine_lines.explanation_ar: his تعني «ـه» لشيء يملكه رجل، و her تعني «ـها» لشيء تملكه امرأة. الاختيار يعتمد على صاحب الشيء، لا على الشيء نفسه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "His" is for a man's thing, "her" is for a woman's thing. It depends on the owner, not the thing.

examples.sentence: What's his name? His name's Tim.
What's her name? Her name's Sian.

fine_lines.title: I'm / my
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I'm = I am (أنا)، أما my فتعني «ـي» للملكية. نقول: I'm Tim أو My name's Tim، ولا نقول My is Tim.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I'm" means "I am". "My" shows something belongs to you.

expressions.meaning_en: a friendly way to ask someone's name
expressions.example: Hello, what's your name? - I'm Tim.

expressions.meaning_en: the easy way to say your name
expressions.example: Hi, I'm Tim. I'm from Oxford.

expressions.meaning_en: another way to say your name
what you say when you meet someone for the first time
expressions.example: Hello, I'm Ali. - Nice to meet you.

expressions.meaning_en: the reply to "Nice to meet you"
expressions.example: Nice to meet you, Ali. - Nice to meet you too.

expressions.meaning_en: ask the name of a man
expressions.example: What's his name? - His name's Buli.

expressions.meaning_en: ask the name of a woman
expressions.example: What's her name? - Her name's Sian.

expressions.meaning_en: ask the names of two or more people
expressions.example: What are their names? - He's Buli. She's Georgie.

grammar.title: Verb to be with names: I'm / he's / she's
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم فعل الكون (be) لتعريف الأشخاص: I am (I'm)، he is (he's)، she is (she's)، they are (they're). في الكلام نستخدم الصيغة المختصرة غالبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the verb "be" to say who people are: I'm, he's, she's, they're. In speaking we usually use the short forms.

grammar.title: Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, their
grammar.explanation_ar: تأتي هذه الكلمات قبل الاسم لتبيّن صاحبه: my name (اسمي)، your name (اسمك)، his name (اسمه)، her name (اسمها)، their names (أسماؤهم). لا تتغير مع المفرد أو الجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: These words go before a noun to show who it belongs to: my, your, his, her, their.

grammar.title: Questions with What's ...?
grammar.explanation_ar: What's = What is. نستخدمها للسؤال عن الاسم: What's your name? ومع الجمع نستخدم What are: What are their names?
grammar.explanation_en: "What's" = "What is". Use "What are" with plural nouns.

questions.question: Someone says "Nice to meet you." What is the best reply?
questions.explanation_ar: الرد المعتاد هو Nice to meet you too أي وأنا أيضًا سُررت بلقائك.
questions.explanation_en: The normal reply is "Nice to meet you too."

questions.question: What's ___ name? - Her name's Sian.
questions.explanation_ar: الجواب عن امرأة (Her name's Sian)، لذا نسأل بـ her.
questions.explanation_en: The answer is about a woman, so we ask with "her".

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: الصحيح I'm Tim = I am Tim.

questions.question: Buli is a man. ___ name's Buli.
questions.explanation_ar: بولي رجل، لذا نقول His name.
questions.explanation_en: Buli is a man, so we say "His".

questions.question: What does "surname" mean?
questions.explanation_en: A surname is your family name.

questions.question: Which question asks about two people?
questions.explanation_en: "Their" is for two or more people.

questions.question: "Hi" is ...
questions.explanation_ar: Hi طريقة غير رسمية لقول مرحبًا.
questions.explanation_en: "Hi" is an informal way to say hello.

questions.question: Complete: "Hello, I'm Tim." - "Hi, Tim. ___"
questions.explanation_ar: عندما يعرّف شخص بنفسه أولًا نقول Nice to meet you، وتأتي too في الرد عليها.
questions.explanation_en: When someone first introduces himself, say "Nice to meet you." "Too" comes in the reply.
